observations.groups: D7A2: 4, 6BE9: 4 — breaks fall after (1) '# Slack' header + heading + '外部に出る' line, (2) 宛先/差出人 pair, (3) body message (2 lines), (4) 出所 line, then the button row separately.
observations.gap_variation: cannot tell — the two layouts read as the same spacing rhythm to me; I cannot confidently see one image having clearly tighter and clearly wider gaps mixed together more than the other.
observations.gap_source_to_buttons: cannot tell — the gap between the 出所 line and the button row looks the same size in both images.
observations.empty_band: neither — I do not see a band of unexplained blank space in either image; all visible gaps sit between identifiable content groups.
observations.content_lost: D7A2 has a small '>' chevron after '10:42' on the 出所 line that is not present in 6BE9. I checked all other lines (# Slack, heading, 外部に出る, 宛先 #sales, 差出人 あなた, the body message, 出所 週次同期・田中・10:42, and the Cancel/Edit/送る buttons) and found no other text or element differences.

why.grouping_legibility: Both use the same spacing pattern to separate header/heading, recipient fields, body message, and source line — I cannot see a legibility difference between them.
why.visual_craft: Typography, color, and alignment appear identical between the two; the only visible difference is the small chevron on the 出所 line, which is too minor to call a craft advantage on its own.
why.information_hierarchy: D7A2's chevron after the 出所 line signals that the source is an inspectable/expandable reference, giving that piece of metadata a clearer role than in 6BE9 where it reads as plain inert text.
why.scan_speed: The 宛先 and 差出人 fields and the body text are laid out identically in both, so finding 'what will happen' and 'to whom' takes the same time in either image.
why.control_reachability: The button row sits at the same distance from the content in both images, so the buttons feel equally connected (or stranded) either way.
why.screen_occupation: Both cards appear to use the same overall height and margins; I see no difference in how much of the screen each occupies.
why.overall: The layouts are essentially identical; D7A2 gets a slight edge purely because the chevron on the 出所 line adds a small affordance/hierarchy cue that 6BE9 lacks, with no offsetting difference found elsewhere.
